Build a Shipment module · 4 of 4
Testing · quality gates · release lifecycle

TDD-first. DevOps-first.
The same gates every Payment Base module ships under.

Test pyramid
  • Unit tests own logic. Mock interfaces, not final classes — if a class is final, extract a seam.
  • Integration tests own the wiring — Doctrine writes, event chains, DI construction.
  • Playwright owns the browser surface. One regression spec per user-facing feature that crosses a frame boundary.
  • Coverage must not shrink between sprints. Enforced in CI.
Sample test · handler in isolation
public function testReservesEachItem(): void {
    $inv = $this->createMock(InventoryService::class);
    $inv->expects($this->exactly(2))
        ->method('reserve');

    $h = new StockReservationHandler($inv);
    $h->handle(new ContractCreatedEvent(
        $contract, new EventContext()
    ));
}
Quality gates · pre-commit
$ ./bin/pre-commit-check.sh

[1/6] PHPCS  (PSR-12) … OK
[2/6] PHPStan (level 6) … OK
[3/6] PHPMD … OK
[4/6] Unit tests … OK
[5/6] Architecture grep guards
      — no PSP imports … OK
      — no direct contract mutations
        in controllers … OK
[6/6] Module activation smoke
      deactivate → activate → clear … OK
SOLID enforced
  • S — one class, one reason to change
  • O — tagged registries over switch ($carrier)
  • L — handlers honour declared input type
  • I — small interfaces; split before 10 public methods
  • D — constructor inject interfaces
Architecture invariants
  • Peers, not dependents. Stripe, PayPal, Shipping module, OpalReturns share Payment Base — never each other.
  • No direct contract mutations. Dispatch, don’t mutate. Grep guard in one-page-checkout/bin/pre-commit-check.sh.
  • One Payment tab. Tagged panel providers contribute — no per-module admin tabs.
  • Shared settings live in Payment Base. Live/test mode, debug flag, capture mode — via PaymentConfigServiceInterface.
  • Drop deprecated immediately. No @deprecated windows on internal code; rename + delete in one commit.
Release shape
  • Composer package; semver; per-module CHANGELOG
  • Doctrine migrations shipped with the module if it owns tables
  • Activation smoke (deactivate → activate → cache-clear) runs in pre-commit when metadata.php changes
  • Reference impls (Stripe, PayPal, OpalReturns) in CI as integration partners
The compounding payoff. Every new module — PSP, returns, shipping, BNPL, marketplace — arrives faster than the one before. The events already exist. The contract lifecycle already exists. The admin tab already exists. The quality gates already exist. Payment Base is the asset; everything else is a tagged service.
